gascityCockpit.dashboard.url.markdownDescription: URL of the gascity dashboard to **project** (embed) into a Cockpit webview tab (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:5173`). Leave empty to show a configure placeholder. The dashboard must be embeddable — webview-safe framing/CSP — and is themed and given tokenized `/v0` access from the host over the embed bridge, so do **not** put an API token in this URL. Run `GasCity Cockpit: Open Dashboard` to project it.
